summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the new StampSlam animation on the Home tab + regression on tabs and /admin. Logo renders at 220x132 in the hero (visually confirmed via screenshot), 'Hospice Sales Coaching' headline below it, AsyncStorage key 'stamp_slam_home_hero' is correctly set to today's ISO date (2026-06-06) after first slam, splatter pulse fades (no persistent red glow in DOM after animation), no React errors in console, all other tabs (Method, AI Tools, Learn, More) render, and /admin works end-to-end with the rotated token JvAvVYHsxECbQDWzXttacXQAKcRlUrMnGkx3--UTS1o (overview/contacts/eligibility load).
critical_code_review_comments: StampSlam.tsx uses useNativeDriver: true on RN Web which logs a fallback warning ('Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation'). Cosmetic/web-only; functionality is unaffected because the JS-driven animation still completes and Animated.Image renders the final state. If the web fallback warning is unwanted, gate useNativeDriver on Platform.OS !== 'web'.
Pre-existing warnings remain (acceptable per request): shadow* deprecation, props.pointerEvents deprecation, expo-notifications web no-op.

Per-day dedupe key works (verified: localStorage shows {stamp_slam_home_hero: '2026-06-06'} after first load; navigating away to Method then back to Home does not re-trigger because of the AsyncStorage + sessionPlayedRef guard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: StampSlam component on Home hero is functional on web. Verification approach: clear localStorage, navigate to /, wait ~2.5s for the slam animation to settle, then (a) confirm an with src containing 'spartan-logo' is present at 220x132 inside the hero, (b) confirm localStorage['stamp_slam_home_hero'] equals today's YYYY-MM-DD, (c) confirm the splatter View (background rgba(239,68,68,0.35)) is either absent or has opacity 0 after ~1s, (d) verify hero title 'Hospice Sales Coaching' is rendered. Note: in RN-Web, Animated.Image may report computedStyle.opacity = '0' even when the logo is visible (RN-Web applies the animated value via internal style updates that don't always propagate to getComputedStyle reads in headless Chromium). Trust the screenshot, not getComputedStyle for the animated img on web. The bottom tab bar uses textContent on inner labels that are NOT exact-match top-level (Method tab and others were clickable via get_by_text('Method', exact=True).first.click(force=True)).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
